scope: One recovery and consistency check from saved selections and predictions; no repeat fits or test prediction generation
estimator_self_check: GCV matches dense hat matrix with an unpenalized intercept; target-shift invariant
serialization_regression_test: Python integer count serializes; both tests pass
interpretation: GCV typically chooses stronger ridge, with small PCC increases and worse aggregate RMSE/MAE. This fixed-geometry comparison does not establish an optimal shrinkage rule or exclude other regularization mechanisms.
limits: Geometry was originally chosen jointly with lambda by inner PCC; GCV only replaces the final development-set lambda rule. No joint GCV geometry search or REML comparison was run. These outer folds have been reused for research; no significance claims or environment-specific rule selection.
